task: chant-forge flagship (allocate.py row 9): the milestone 'a range preset per choir (--choir amateur|textbook|octave)'

doc_friction.issue: The row's next: was 1910 of 2000 characters; replacing the landed item with a one-line pointer plus the next item still went over the cap, so two older items had to be shortened too. A cap-aware hint (characters free after removing the landed item) would save a validate round trip.

deviations.why: The milestone named only the presets. A preset that only fills four flags saves typing but answers nothing; the question a director has is which voicing their choir needs.
deviations.did: Also made --choir set the unison range to the band every section reaches and, when unison fails, name the fewest sections that fit (fewestSections in voicefit.mjs), with a corpus report.
deviations.result: The report turned up a real finding: the default E2-E4 unison range fits all 67 files, but the band textbook tenors and basses share fits 60.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id

certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
